🚨 NVIDIA is SELLING the chips powering the AI boom.

AND it's BANKROLLING the companies buying them.

$30 BILLION into OpenAI. Up to $10 billion for Anthropic. $5 billion for Intel. Billions more across AI startups, data centers and infrastructure.

Nvidia is now connected to practically every corner of the industry.

It invests in AI companies. Those companies raise more money, build data centers and buy Nvidia chips.

The money can end up flowing RIGHT BACK to Nvidia.

With Jensen Huang gone and Wall Street questioning the AI spending frenzy, those relationships are suddenly getting much more scrutiny.

Because if AI demand slows, Nvidia could get hit TWICE: by falling chip sales and losses on the companies it helped finance.

HOW MUCH of this boom can survive without Nvidia helping pay for it?
